lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-intensity white circular blobs arranged in approximately 10-12 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with each column containing 3-6 distinct spots.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a lattice-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the primary medial ridge exhibits a sharp intensity gradient with high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge and deep shadow pixels on the ventral edge, running parallel to the lateral line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 18-22 scattered high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, concentrated primarily in the basal and central regions of the fin.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is visible attached to the ventral region immediately posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge.
